newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOLVAY IN TALKS ABOUT SODI STAKE SALE.
newsitem.headline: SOLVAY IN TALKS ABOUT SODI STAKE SALE.

text.p: Belgian chemicals group Solvay SA said on Monday it was in advanced talks with Turkish glass and chemicals producer Sise Cam about sellling part of its stake in Bulgarian soda ash producer SODI to Sise Cam.

"Solvay and Sise Cam intend to share the soda ash production of SODI on a 75/25 basis, each party selling its share of the production both in Bulgaria and on export markets through its own organisations," Solvay said in a statement.
Negotiations were also progressing with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, which was also expected to join the project. it said.

Solvay gave no details on how its 60 percent stake in SODI would be split up, but last Tuesday Sise Cam said in Istanbul that in buying 25 percent of Solvay's stake, it would own about 17 percent of SODI and get about 250,000 tonnes of its output.
In December Solvay paid Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency $160 million for its stake.
